step_1_are_there_pinned_slots.question: Does Syndra's order have any slot fixed by a setup/consume edge, leaving the rest 'free'?
step_1_are_there_pinned_slots.finding: Yes. Q is the sole applier of Dark Spheres ('conjures a Dark Sphere ... remains on the ground for 6 seconds'). W consumes one ('grabs the nearest Dark Sphere'), E consumes/enhances on one ('Dark Spheres can be knocked back ... stunned for 1.25 seconds'), and R scales on live ones ('grabs up to 4 nearby live ones' -> 3 to 7 spheres, i.e. Minimum 240/360/480 vs Maximum 560/840/1120). So the detector pins Q first and W, E, R remain unpinned = 'free slots'. A rationale entry describing how the free slots were ordered is therefore warranted; an order derivation for Syndra that emitted no such entry would be under-explaining a genuinely DPS-ranked decision.
step_1_are_there_pinned_slots.consequence_for_old_value: old value <absent> is an incomplete citation set

step_2_per_rank_dps_formula.formula: per_rank_DPS(ability) = total_raw(rank, stats) / effective_cooldown, effective_cooldown = base_cd * 100 / (100 + ability_haste)  [CLAUDE.md haste rule; f3-task.md ranking rule]

max_rank_totals_level_18.W_rank5: (190 + 0.65*AP) magic, plus true = (12% + 2% per 100 AP) of that -> total_raw = (190+0.65*AP)*(1.12 + 0.0002*AP); cross-check vs cached 'Total Mixed Damage' row at AP=0: 190*1.12 = 212.8, wiki row = 212.8 EXACT MATCH; cd 8
max_rank_totals_level_18.R_rank3: minimum (3 guaranteed conjured spheres) 480 + 0.60*AP, cd 80; maximum (7 spheres) 1120 + 1.40*AP

step_3_matrix_sweep.note: A uniform ability-haste h scales every haste-affected cooldown by the same factor (1+h/100), so it cannot reorder W/E/R; only AP can. Swept AP in {0,200,400,700,1000} x haste in {0,40,100}.
step_3_matrix_sweep.table_haste40_and_100: identical free-slot order ['W','E','R'] at every AP point (haste is a common factor on all three)
closed_form_checks: W - E > 0 for all AP >= 0: (190+0.65A)(1.12+0.0002A)/8 - (200+0.6A)/15 has value 13.27 at A=0 and derivative positive throughout -> W outranks E everywhere.
E - R_min > 0 for all AP >= 0: (13.333 + 0.04A) - (6 + 0.0075A) = 7.333 + 0.0325A > 0 always -> E outranks R everywhere.

Only corner where the ranking is not strict: if R's total_raw were taken as the MAXIMUM (7 spheres, 14+0.0175A) instead of the guaranteed minimum, R would edge past E for AP < ~21 only; every scenario with any AP purchased keeps E > R.
step_3_matrix_sweep.conclusion: The free-slot ranking is W > E > R at every point of the (AP x haste) matrix. The claim 'consistent across the matrix' is verified, and it satisfies f3-task.md invariant 2c ('the order is stable across levels/items for the same champion').

independent_computation.step_4_full_derived_order: Q (pinned by the sphere setup edge) then W, E, R by per-rank DPS = Q -> W -> E -> R. Note Q's own cooldown is flagged affectedByCdr=false in the cache and is instead cut by R's passive ability haste (10/20/30), which only strengthens Q's already-pinned lead position and never touches the free-slot comparison.

caveats: FIDELITY NIT (does not change the verdict): the repo's own definition in data/worklists/f3-task.md is 'total_raw / effective cooldown x AoE weight'. The new leaf quotes only 'total_raw / effective cooldown', dropping the AoE-weight factor. For Syndra this is immaterial - Q/W/E are all AoE and R is a single-target barrage, so any AoE weight >= 1 pushes R further down and leaves W > E > R untouched. The abbreviation is a prose simplification, not a computational error. If the leaf is meant to be a verbatim statement of the ranking rule, restoring 'x AoE weight' would make it exact.

The trailing clause '- consistent across the matrix' reads as a verifier annotation rather than part of a rationale string. Its factual content is independently confirmed above (the ranking really is invariant across the AP x haste matrix), so it is true as written, but it is stylistically unlike a citation.

docs/math-foundations.md carries no order-derivation rule at all; the mechanism is only specified in data/worklists/f3-task.md. If this ranking is now a load-bearing engine rule, math-foundations.md Section 1.1 is the place it is missing from.

The literal string stored at sources[7] could not be reproduced character-for-character from data/ alone; the verdict is on the substance (entry warranted + mechanism correct + matrix-consistency claim true), not on exact string equality.
verdict_reasoning: old_value <absent> is wrong because Syndra genuinely has one edge-pinned slot (Q) and three unpinned ones (W, E, R) whose relative order comes purely from the per-rank DPS ranking - that decision needs a citation. new_value is correct: the mechanism it names is the repo's documented ranking rule (modulo the omitted AoE-weight factor, which is inert for Syndra), and the 'consistent across the matrix' claim is confirmed by direct computation from the cached wiki damage and cooldown rows - W > E > R at every AP in {0,200,400,700,1000} and every haste in {0,40,100}.
